info.name: Combined roster for the broker team page.

items.docs:
Returns the agency's team members merged with email-integration mailbox
users in a single list, deduplicated by email address:
- Every team member appears once with ``source: "team"``. When a mailbox
  user with the same email exists, it is attached as ``email_user``.
- Mailbox users with no matching team member appear as ``source: "email"``
  rows (admin and maintainer requesters only), with the team-member fields
  set to null and the mailbox data in ``email_user``.
